name: unstuck-cloudflare-agent
description: An Agents SDK agent opens a page in Cloudflare Browser Rendering, hands a step to a person with Unstuck, and carries on.

UNSTUCK_API_KEY.description: Your Unstuck Cloud API key (`uk_live_…`), from [unstuck.sh/dashboard/keys](https://unstuck.sh/dashboard/keys). Running your own relay instead? Leave this empty and set `UNSTUCK_RELAY_URL` and `UNSTUCK_AGENT_KEY` with `wrangler secret put` after deploying.

CONTROL_TOKEN.description: A shared secret that protects every request to the agent. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

TARGET_URL.description: The page the agent opens and hands to you. Default: `https://example.com`.

UNSTUCK_ALERTS.description: Phone alerts with Unstuck Cloud: `on` (default: alert your paired phones, log the link if none got it), `required` (fail at once with `alert_failed` if no paired phone got it: for unattended runs) or `off`.

LINK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional secret: an incoming webhook (Slack, Discord or your own `https://` endpoint) that gets the takeover link as JSON the moment a person is needed. Recommended with a self-hosted relay, which sends no phone alerts. Set it with `wrangler secret put LINK_WEBHOOK_URL`.
